name: code
description: Code learning, explanation, documentation, comment-drafting, planning, TDD, architecture, Beads task, Beads-tracked pair-programming, and todo-generation workflows for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Learn, explain, document, comment, plan, TDD, architect, execute tasks, pair with Beads tracking, and draft todos.
interface.longDescription: Code provides teaching-oriented workflows for broad project learning, explaining unfamiliar code, writing code documentation artifacts, drafting comments for specific code blocks, creating exhaustive implementation plans, implementing behavior through test-driven development, decomposing architecture work into phased Beads tasks, continuing Beads tasks from accepted plans, pair-programming through code changes without editing files while tracking remaining chunks in Beads, and generating issue-tracker-ready todo artifacts.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $code:learn for sourced broad-topic project learning, $code:describe to learn how specific code works, $code:document to write a code documentation artifact, $code:comment to draft and optionally insert a contextual comment, $code:plan to create an implementation-ready plan, $code:tdd to implement behavior through red-green TDD loops, $code:architect to decompose architecture work into phased Beads tasks, $code:task to continue a Beads task from an accepted plan, $code:pair to pair-program without Codex editing files while tracking remaining chunks in Beads, or $code:todo to draft an issue-tracker-ready Markdown todo.
